data: Use only the 50 reconstructed tuning images per dataset; seal all configs before reading 1000-image evaluation metrics.
track: Select released_code_v1 or separately qualified paper_formula adapter; never merge their results.

seeds.measurement_rule: SHA256(namespace/dataset/image_id/operator) first8 bytes little-endian; freeze exact generator and tensors before any run.

proposed_inverse_strength_grid.rationale: A factor-two neighborhood around audited TableE.2 values; proposed independent replication design, not recovered author grid.

selection_objective: Choose and seal the per-task primary metric and deterministic tie break before running tuning; currently unresolved.
baseline_tuning: Requires baseline environments and explicit equal-budget policy; not supplied by this draft.
cost_model: Count all attempted tuning cells, actual transformer forward/recompute/backward, VAE, reward and K3 warmup/discarded selection, transfer, wall time and peak VRAM. NFE labels are not actual counters.
timing: Obtain bounded per-component timings only after adapters/evaluators/data measurement manifests qualify. No full-matrix timing extrapolation from old pilot.
remaining_decisions: primary tuning metric and tie break
